answer: A payout is split so that 34% arrives at settlement and the rest over 18 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The juniper schedule is applied in forge and zephyr publishes each instalment. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4232 identities would post 1118 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
